reason: The task requires a replay-rate scalar keyed to repeated refund_id occurrences, but existing tools only expose daily_net_sales, refund_rate, and category_ranking, and existing plugins only deduplicate or cap refund events. Neither deduplication nor capping reports a replay proportion, so the expected result refund_replay_rate is unavailable; a minimal metric_tool computing replay rows over total refund rows fills exactly this gap.
